title: BlackboardCalculation
description: A CALCULATION entry: a deterministic computation a worker performed over named inputs (e.g. summing exposure across observations). formula records the rule, inputs[] the operands (typically entry_ids or literal values it consumed), result the output, and checked records whether the calculation was independently re-derived/verified. A calculation is derived working state, not served truth; the matching BlackboardEntry row (kind=calculation) carries serves_truth=false. checked=true is evidence the math holds, NOT authority to publish.

entry_id.description: id of the BlackboardEntry (kind=calculation) this body belongs to

blackboard_id.description: the blackboard this calculation belongs to

inputs.description: the named operands consumed (entry_ids and/or literal value references) — lineage to what was computed over

result.description: the computed output, recorded as a string for exact, formatting-stable capture

checked.description: true if the calculation was independently re-derived/verified; evidence, not publication authority
